summary: In June 2024, two people were arrested in Fatehabad, Haryana for the rape resulting in death or persistent vegetative state involving a minor. The charges also include murder, kidnapping and abduction. Police have filed a chargesheet. The accused were convicted. An appeal against the verdict has been filed. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Rape resulting in death or persistent vegetative state involving a minor — Fatehabad (2024
